# configuration file C:\nginx/conf/nginx.conf:
worker_processes  1;

events {
    worker_connections  1024;
}

http {
    include       mime.types;
    default_type  application/octet-stream;

    server {
        listen       80;
        server_name  localhost;
        location / {
            root   html;
        }
    }

    include C:\Nginx\Conf\sites-enabled\*;
    include conf.d/*.conf;
}

stream {
    include streams-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file C:\nginx/conf/mime.types:

    text/html  html htm shtml;
}
